Kapok YouTube IFrame Player adapter
Copyright 2026 Kapok contributors.

player-island.js is Kapok source. It contains no third-party library code.
When the user loads a player, the adapter requests the YouTube IFrame Player
API from YouTube. The API and embedded player are provided by YouTube.

API documentation: https://developers.google.com/youtube/iframe_api_reference
YouTube API Services terms: https://developers.google.com/youtube/terms/api-services-terms-of-service
